reviews.text: I was in desperate need of getting my babies in last minute prior to the nor’easter hitting and Ren was there to help even insisted on staying much later to give me time to get there . She was very professional and knowledgeable about cats and ultimately help with their chronic vomiting . I live in CT but will definitely come back just as long as she works there . Thanks

If you’re with a 10 mile radius and you don’t come to this vet for their prompt, friendly service, you’re wasting time, money and energy. This place has parking, a friendly staff and a well knowledged vet with many years under his belt. You would be foolish to go somewhere else where they are going to nickel and dime you and not provide the service that I have received today. I’ve been to many vets and I will tell you by far. This is the best place I’ve been to. They assisted me in using Chewy, the pharmaceutical app and they easily could have pointed me in another direction to make Of a profit. It took me quite some time to find this place, but I’m telling you it’s well worth it.

I was lucky to find Dr. M and staff over 10 years ago. When my cat at the time Marbles jumped into some floor glue (I was getting new tiles in my living room) and they took him the same day. Unfortunately, they had to shave him. Which was a necessity. But he saved my boy.
I've been a loyal client since. I have brought all my cats here for any medical needs as well as vaccines. I truly appreciate Dr. M and his staff. And I will continue to be a client until he retires, which I hope is not anytime soon.
Always bring my fur babies to this location. They are truly helpful

These people really do care about your pet's health and are very friendly and knowledgeable. They are also gentle when handling pet's which I absolutely love. They where willing to work with my brother on the price for ensuring his dogs health wich truly shows how much they care. This will be my permanent vet's office from now on and I highly recommend them.
Great place! Great staff, friendly, informative, took good care of my new puppy.  I recommend this Vet
Always a good service.
Took two different cats here to be taken care of and put down. Ren is the best, and I’ll be coming back with my next cat very soon. Thank you again Ren ❤️

Brought my dog when she was sick and they had last-minute availability.  The place is bare bones which is fine, however the vet is really unprofessional, diagnosed my dog with a UTI without any urine sample, drew up the antibiotic shot and vaccines and left the needles open while waving them around and speaking.  My dog is still sick, I spent over $600 and will now have to bring her to another vet that's cleaner and actually can diagnose her.  Go elsewhere.
I've been here several times with my cats teeth cleaning and check ups staff is great

This tri boro Animal Hospital is absolutely, amazing, professional and accommodating they care for ur pets the employees are very courteous I would recommend this Animal Hospital to everyone I rate this place 5 stars 🌟 …

Love it they are very knowledgeable and very compassionate and great with my babies and great prices also get military discount here where I never got anywhere before!  Ren is great totally recommend speaking to her if you have any questions!

Very quick , professional and accommodating. I was able to book a last minute appointment for rabbies shots for my two cats. I was seen on time and was on and out on 30mins. Everyone was extremely nice

I brought my little Stonie here and she was really calm and well behaved which proved to me that she liked the energy of the staff who were courteous, kind and very efficient in everything they did! Im glad I found this place and worth the money! They are transparent! Especially since my cat is my baby!☺️
Great hospital
They’re hands down the best vet in the area
Great service
They take good care of my dogs and I find them more affordable than other animal hospitals in the area. The staff is also nicer than some others I've encountered.

They are very unprofessional and the doctor does not care he has been in the field for more than 40 years and me and all of my family members have been bringing our pet here for over 12 years. since then recently he is very old and should retire he made me spend $2,000 in medicine when my dog needed surgery to begin with he does not what he is doing I would never recommend anyone to go and I will tell my family to stop going and I am planning to protest this horrible place

Love this place ! Have been going there before it moved to Lurting ave. Grand concourse. Dr Marienberg is such a sweet and kind vet. He does everything in front of you and is very gentle with your babies ♥️. The receptionist is very knowledgeable and so is the vet assistant staff.

I took my Tabby Cat Ember, to get looked at because her stomach had a weird bulge. I addressed that she might be pregnant upon my walk-in & when she got examined by the main Vet he told me that she had a hernia and she was indeed not pregnant .
I’m here at an animal hospital (blue pearl midtown) & they told me she is currently pregnant. Now I’m not the one to write a review but how can you miss that?.
She currently is undergoing surgery.

These guys were great with helping me calm down about my animals having to get shots and my animals were so calm also overall great experience.
It's a pet friendly environment, but those waiting seats..........
